shortDescription: Unifor said the current labor deal expires on Sept. 20. "Stellantis Talks With Canadian Workers Hit Impasse on Plan to Sell Ontario Factory, Union Says," at 4:04 p.m. ET, incorrectly said the labor deal expires on Aug. 20.
